items.what: Status line class must be accessible as LeoQtFrame.QtStatusLineClass and expose a textWidget1 attribute (constructible via object.__new__ without full frame).
Status line must support setFocus() as a safe callable (no-op).
Status line must implement isEnabled() returning a bool, and it must remain a bool after enable()/disable() calls.
QHeadlineWrapper flashCharacter must accept a 5-argument call signature flashCharacter(i, bg, bg2, flashCount, flashDelay) as a no-op.
QHeadlineWrapper getXScrollPosition/getYScrollPosition must return ints that stay stable (not mutated by setXScrollPosition/setYScrollPosition no-ops).
StringTextWrapper must gain no-op disable()/enable() while getAllText() keeps working.

reason: The instruction deliberately delegates the exact method set, signatures, and return conventions to 'existing wrapper/status-line conventions in the repository', and the required names (disable/enable, setFocus, isEnabled, get/setX/YScrollPosition, flashCharacter) are the standard Leo wrapper API a repo-convention-following fix would supply, so most items are guessable; class/attribute names like QtStatusLineClass and textWidget1 are repo internals verified automatically.
